{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq (i.e., re-tests)
duplicate_patients = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(duplicate_patients)}")

# Check for max sample_seq per patient
duplicates_by_id = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {duplicates_by_id.max()}")"}
